audit_method: primary-source verification: official dataset repositories (OpenNeuro CRN GraphQL API, OpenNeuro S3 mirror, GitHub), preprint/journal methods sections, dataset_description.json and events sidecar files fetched directly. Not based on abstracts alone.

decision.note: Determination is based on official metadata, sidecar JSON, raw file listing, and paper methods text verified directly. The exact trigger-code-to-condition mapping has not yet been decoded from raw data (requires Commit 2 ingestion); this is a residual risk carried into C1_PROTOCOL.md, not a blocker for the Phase 0 decision.

candidates.official_title: A Human EEG Dataset for Multisensory Perception and Mental Imagery (YOTO: You Only Think Once)
candidates.modality: EEG; visual, auditory, and multimodal (audiovisual) perception + imagery
candidates.trial_level_behavior_description: Each trial: fixation (2s) -> stimulus presentation / perception (2s) -> mental imagery of the same stimulus (4s) -> self-report of vividness on a 1-5 scale, per trial. No accuracy or reaction-time target is reported.
candidates.approximate_trial_count: 384 trials/participant (2 sessions x 4 blocks x 48 trials); ~7680 trials total across all modality conditions, visual-only subset is a fraction of this (exact split requires trigger-code decode)
candidates.derivatives_available: ASR + ICA-cleaned, resampled to 250Hz, per-subject/session EEGLAB .set files plus removed-component logs and a task_event.mat per session (not yet decoded)
candidates.event_metadata_quality: Mixed: dataset_description.json, eeg.json, and events.json/tsv are present and BIDS-valid, but the task eeg.json TaskDescription field for the 'task' run incorrectly copies resting-state instructions text (a metadata authoring bug); events.tsv trigger 'value' codes (21-47 observed) are not self-documenting and require decoding against the paper's stimulus table before use.
candidates.randomization_quality: Paper reports a 'weighted randomization strategy' interleaving conditions within blocks (not simple blocking by modality/condition), but exact per-block composition has not been independently verified from raw data.
candidates.known_block_or_temporal_confounds: Partial risk: 4 blocks/session structure exists; residual confound between block index and stimulus category has not been empirically ruled out and must be checked in Commit 3 QC before confirmatory use.
candidates.license: CC0 1.0 (public domain; was CC-BY-4.0 before 2025-01-12, relicensed to CC0)
candidates.download_method: OpenNeuro web UI / DataLad / aws s3 sync s3://openneuro.org/ds005815 (verified reachable directly)
candidates.checksum_support: S3 object ETag (MD5) and CRC64NVME per file; BIDS/DataLad annex; independent SHA-256 to be computed on ingestion per this project's convention
candidates.BIDS_status: BIDS 1.10.0 compliant (raw), derivatives present but not BIDS-derivatives-labeled

candidates.official_title: EEG-based BCI Dataset of Semantic Concepts for Imagination and Perception Tasks
candidates.modality: EEG; visual pictorial, visual orthographic (written words), and auditory comprehension; imagination vs perception tasks
candidates.trial_level_behavior_description: Vividness assessed via VVIQ/BAIS-V questionnaires at the participant level only. No trial-level accuracy, confidence, or vividness rating is recorded.
candidates.session_count: 9 participants x 1 session, 3 participants x 2 sessions
candidates.event_metadata_quality: Good: event labels are self-documenting (e.g. 'Imagination_a_flower_high_5' encodes task, stimulus, modality variant, speaker/pitch id).
candidates.randomization_quality: Not explicitly addressed in the methods section.
candidates.known_block_or_temporal_confounds: One block per modality cycled sequentially before a rest break (~7 minutes per cycle) — condition/modality may be confounded with block-level time-on-task; not fully randomized at the trial level.
rejection_reasons: No trial-level behavioral target of any kind (accuracy, confidence, vividness) is recorded; only participant-level questionnaire scores exist, which fails the requirement that the behavioral target be an observed trial-level variable.
Condition/modality is cycled in blocks rather than confirmed randomized, an unresolved temporal-confound risk.
candidates.usable_for: Exploratory H1 (reliability) and H3/H4 (perception-imagery representational transfer) only, never as the primary confirmatory H2 incremental-validity dataset.

candidates.official_title: A large and rich EEG dataset for modeling human visual object recognition (THINGS-EEG2)
candidates.event_metadata_quality: Good, well documented, widely reused benchmark.
candidates.randomization_quality: Rapid serial visual presentation, documented in methods; no imagery condition to confound.
candidates.known_block_or_temporal_confounds: None reported for the perception-only design.
candidates.license: Not fully confirmed in this audit pass (OSF project terms; treat as research-use until license file is checked in Commit 2 ingestion).
rejection_reasons: No imagery condition at all — cannot support H2/H3 primary claims on its own.
candidates.usable_for: Tier B: subject-invariant perception encoder pretraining and external replication of H1/H3 perception-side representation quality.

candidates.official_title: Alljoined-1.6M: A Million-Trial EEG-Image Dataset for Evaluating Affordable Brain-Computer Interfaces
candidates.approximate_trial_count: 1.6 million trials (largest EEG-image dataset identified in this audit)
candidates.randomization_quality: Not verified in this audit pass.
candidates.known_block_or_temporal_confounds: Not verified in this audit pass.
rejection_reasons: NC-SA license clause restricts commercial use and requires share-alike on any derived artifact; must be explicitly disclosed if used.
candidates.usable_for: Tier B: large-scale consumer-grade-hardware perception pretraining and cross-hardware generalization checks only.

candidates.official_title: EEG-ImageNet (Spampinato et al. visual classification dataset)
candidates.paper_doi_or_identifier: Spampinato et al. CVPR 2017; filtered-data reproducibility critique: Li, Kavasidis et al., 'Training on the test set? An analysis of Spampinato et al.', arXiv:1812.07697 (2018)
candidates.approximate_trial_count: 2000 images x 40 classes, block-presented per participant
candidates.minimally_processed_available: Two incompatible versions exist (original 'unfiltered' vs a 2020 'filtered' release) — a documented reproducibility hazard.
candidates.randomization_quality: Block-based stimulus presentation (all trials of one class presented consecutively).
candidates.known_block_or_temporal_confounds: CONFIRMED in the literature: Li et al. 2018 showed high published classification accuracy was driven by slow temporal drift correlated with block order, not stimulus content — a canonical example of exactly the leakage this project's admissibility criteria are designed to exclude.
candidates.license: Not verified in this audit pass.
rejection_reasons: Documented, peer-reviewed block/temporal confound that invalidated prior published results on this exact dataset — excluded from this project even for pretraining use to avoid inheriting a known leakage pathway.
candidates.usable_for: Negative-control reference only: cited in C1_ANALYSIS_SPEC.md as the canonical example motivating the block/temporal-confound falsification tests, not used as data.

candidates.official_title: OpenMIIR: a public domain dataset of EEG recordings for music imagery information retrieval
candidates.approximate_trial_count: 12 music fragments x repeated perception/imagination trials per participant
candidates.event_metadata_quality: Good, long-established benchmark with existing MNE loaders.
candidates.license: Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and Licence (PDDL)
rejection_reasons: Auditory modality only — cannot support the primary VISUAL imagery claim per the task's explicit scope restriction.
candidates.usable_for: Tier C auxiliary control only: an independent modality-general test of the perception-imagery alignment infrastructure (H4 state-dependence machinery) built in Commit 6, never as evidence for the visual-imagery claim.
